verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's docs let you pin a fixed LibreOffice version for conversions, which implies a first-party office-document conversion engine. They also describe combining documents of any format into a single PDF, which covers part of office-to-PDF output. Nothing in the pack explicitly names Word, Excel or PowerPoint formats, or confirms conversion between office formats. missing for 10: explicit documentation of DOCX/XLSX/PPTX to PDF conversion, conversion between office formats (e.g. DOC↔DOCX, XLSX↔ODS, PPTX↔ODP), fidelity details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
